# The modules the nightly coverage summary reports on their own
# (.github/workflows/ci.yml, job `coverage`): the permission gate, the
# isolation layers, the egress proxy, the approval channel, the stores of
# secrets and audit records, the dashboard server's login, and the code
# that fetches and serves third-party files. One repository path per line;
# tests/test_the_coverage_report_covers_the_whole_suite.py fails for a path
# that does not exist, so a rename cannot drop a module from the report.
